question: In the southern ranges of which hills is Mawsynram, which receives the highest rainfall in the world, located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khasi Hills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mawsynram is located in the southern ranges of the Khasi Hills in the Indian state of Meghalaya.
 
• It is renowned for receiving the highest average annual rainfall in the world, with an average of about 467 inches (11,871 mm).
 
• The Khasi Hills are part of the larger Patkai range, which extends across India and into Myanmar.
 
• Mawsynram's record rainfall is due to its location on the windward side of the hills, where the monsoon winds from the Bay of Bengal are funneled and cause heavy precipitation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shevaroy hills**

 
 
• The Shevaroy Hills are a range of hills located in the Eastern Ghats in Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• They are known for their coffee plantations and the hill station of Yercaud.
 
 
 
• **Mizo hills**
 
 
• The Mizo Hills, also known as Lushai Hills, are part of the Patkai range in the state of Mizoram, India.
 
• These hills are characterized by dense forests and a significant tribal population.
 
 
 
• **Naga hills**
 
 
• The Naga Hills are part of the Purvanchal Range in Nagaland, India.
 
• These hills are named after the Naga tribes who inhabit the region.
 
 

 
• Khasi hills

 
 
• The Khasi Hills are part of the Garo-Khasi range in Meghalaya, India.
 
• They are known for their unique living root bridges and the highest rainfall in Mawsynram.
